title: Visited work-tape head positions
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $q$ be an initial state, and let $V$ be a Boolean input string. For a natural number $t$ and a tape $i$, the visited-position set consists of the positions of tape $i$'s head in the configurations reached from this initial setup at times $0,1,\ldots,t-1$; in particular, it is empty when $t=0$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of time steps $t$
A tape index $i$ among the $k$ work tapes
A $k$-work-tape machine with Boolean input alphabet
